tasks.title: Define the ShipmentDispatched event schema
tasks.scope: Add the JSON Schema for shipment.dispatched. Publishing and consuming are out of scope.
acceptance_criteria: The schema requires orderId, customerEmail and trackingUrl.
A payload without customerEmail fails validation against the schema.

tasks.title: Publish shipment.dispatched when an order is dispatched
tasks.scope: Emit the event from the DISPATCHED transition. Consumer behaviour is out of scope.
tasks.deliverable: Publisher invoked by mark_dispatched, with a unit test
acceptance_criteria: Marking an order DISPATCHED publishes exactly one shipment.dispatched event.
The event payload validates against contracts/shipment_dispatched.json.

tasks.title: Consume shipment.dispatched and email the customer
tasks.scope: Add the consumer and email template. Event publishing is out of scope.
tasks.deliverable: Consumer and template under services/notification, with unit tests
acceptance_criteria: A valid event sends one email to customerEmail containing trackingUrl.
An event without customerEmail sends no email and is recorded as rejected.
The same event delivered twice sends one email.

tasks.title: Verify dispatch-to-email end to end
tasks.scope: One integration test across both services. No production code changes.
acceptance_criteria: Dispatching an order results in exactly one email containing the tracking link.

discrepancies.description: The HLS says the order service publishes no shipment events; the repository confirms there is no publisher yet.
